limitations: Repeatedly observed development sample; 159 configurations include exact duplicate intention paths in some cases and are not 159 independent signals. Time slices inherit original equity and positions; no independent recapitalization, significance test, stage-four perturbation or fee stress. Local peak and inherited peak drawdowns are labelled separately; partial calendar years not annualized. Frontier ignores frequency and is descriptive, not candidate qualification.

finite_domain.scope: Fixed model, threshold, full exposure, canonical historical input only; no claim of independent information or distinct behavior for every representative.
